answer: A ceilidh band membership with gig booking history works as the gate: gigs played under one band name across seasons. Each of 413 aliases needs its own gig histories, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The cipher test is the price tag: 413 fakes mean 413 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The spiral signal is visible to every grader, and the inlet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
